ticket.subject: Duplicate payment for invoice INV-2026-4634
ticket.body_text:
Hi,

Writing on behalf of Tidewell Logistics. We were charged twice for our Scale subscription this month: two payments of $2,490.00 went through on Friday, a few minutes apart.

The second charge has pushed our company card close to its monthly limit.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Could you reverse the second charge and send a corrected receipt?

Best,
Yara

label_notes: clean billing (billing-double-charge): a double charge is P2 in the guide; urgency medium: action needed this week.
